statement: A production sealed confirmation was attempted against real campaign evidence on a same-UID host. It could not produce a qualified result: no independently held evaluator custody exists here, and the campaign's own research record is REFUSED — there is no qualified candidate to confirm. The refusal is the correct, fail-closed output. P5 remains OPEN until a candidate survives matched multi-seed evaluation AND an evaluator on a distinct OS identity verifies it against a fresh sealed benchmark.
